DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) presenting with bone marrow infiltration (severe leg pain), pancytopenia (thrombocytopenia causing bruising, anemia causing fatigue), and leukocytosis.

The combination of severe bone pain, fever, easy bruising, anemia, and thrombocytopenia with high white blood cells in a 3-year-old is highly indicative of leukemia.
